basics.name: Mirela Ionescu
basics.label: Senior Data Engineer
basics.summary: Data engineer with nine years building batch and event-driven pipelines, currently owning the analytics platform for a 400-person UK retailer. Comfortable across Python, Spark and dbt on AWS, with a track record of cutting pipeline cost and runtime rather than adding to it. Moving toward streaming and platform ownership.

work.name: Halcyon Retail Group
work.summary: Own the analytics platform serving merchandising, supply chain and finance across 180 stores and the e-commerce estate.
highlights: Rebuilt the nightly sales and stock pipeline on Spark and Airflow, cutting the critical-path runtime from 6h10m to 1h50m and moving the 07:00 reporting SLA from 'missed twice a month' to zero misses in 14 months.
Reduced AWS spend on the data platform by £14k per month (31%) by replacing 40 always-on EMR hours a day with transient clusters and moving cold history to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval.
Introduced dbt with contract tests and CI on 240 models, cutting production data incidents attributed to schema drift from 11 in 2023 to 2 in 2025.
Built a Kafka-based stock-movement feed consumed by three downstream teams, replacing a 15-minute polling job and bringing store-level stock latency under 30 seconds.
Mentored two junior engineers through their first year, both now shipping to production unsupervised.

work.name: Halcyon Retail Group
highlights: Migrated 60 legacy SQL Server stored procedures to a Redshift and dbt stack, retiring a £40k-per-year licence.
Wrote the ingestion framework still used for all 27 third-party supplier feeds, reducing new-feed onboarding from roughly three days to half a day.
Added Great Expectations checks to the ten highest-impact tables, catching a supplier price-feed corruption before it reached the pricing team.

work.name: Vantiq Software
highlights: Delivered ETL and reporting platforms for six client engagements across insurance and telecoms, each 3-9 months.
Built a Python and Airflow ingestion service processing 4M insurance claim records a day for the largest client.
Cut a client's month-end close reporting run from 9 hours to 40 minutes by rewriting a row-by-row Oracle procedure as set-based SQL.

work.name: Vantiq Software
highlights: Built and maintained Python and Django REST services for client-facing insurance portals.
Introduced the team's first automated test suite, taking coverage on the core billing service from 0% to 71%.

projects.name: stockstream
projects.description: Open-source toolkit for replaying retail stock-movement events against a local Kafka cluster, used for load-testing consumer services.
highlights: Replays 2M recorded events at configurable rates against a local broker.
Around 300 GitHub stars and used by two teams outside the original employer.
